literal_meaning: heedlessness or momentary lapse in attention
figurative_meaning_en: negligence; inattention; indifference; laxity; playing truant
example_sentences_in_bangla: কাজে গাফিলতি করলে সবকিছু নষ্ট হয়ে যাবে।
example_sentences_in_english: I harmed myself due to my negligence.
Neglecting your duties will ruin everything.
history: Derived from the Persian/Arabic word 'ghaflat', meaning spiritual or worldly heedlessness, adapted into Bengali for everyday lapses.
note: The term carries a subtle connotation of self-inflicted harm through inattention, common in Bengali moral teachings.
